Munawar Faruqui Returns to Lock Upp Season 2

Comedian Munawar Faruqui has returned to the reality show "Lock Upp" for its second season. He was seen reviewing the prison-themed set of the show. The show is a popular format featuring celebrity contestants in a jail-like environment.
